top_signals.title: China’s Pork Market Recovery Struggles to Overcome Tepid Demand
top_signals.summary: The Chinese government’s campaign to lift pork prices is finally gaining traction. But the rally is running into a familiar obstacle: consumers still aren’t buying enough.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
